# Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformer Models: Architecture, Training, and Deployment

## 1. Architectural Overview

A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer replaces standard feed-forward networks (FFNs) in a Transformer with a set of $N$ parallel expert networks $\{E_1, E_2, \dots, E_N\}$, each typically being a smaller FFN, and a gating network (router) that dynamically assigns each token to a subset of experts.

### Core Components

```
Input Token x
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────┐
│  Router G() │ ──► Computes expert scores for each expert
└─────────────┘
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          Top-K Expert Selection         │
│  Select K experts per token (sparse)    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
┌──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────┐
│  Expert 1    │  Expert 3    │  Expert N │  ... (only K active)
│  E1(x)       │  E3(x)       │  EN(x)    │
└──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────┘
    │
